title: Annual General Meeting confirms dividend of €1.25 and approves all proposed resolutions
summary: – CEO Dr Jean-Yves Parisot reports on solid growth and increased profitability in the 2025 financial year and progress in transformation – Dividend of €1.25 per share approved – Welcome to three new Supervisory Board members
